items.q: How much does a website cost with Judo Marketing?
items.a: Our websites work as a monthly subscription: Essential Websites from {essential} a month (online stores, bookings, services), Complex Websites from {complex} (delivery, logistics, integrations), and Mobile Apps from {apps}. Everything includes design, support, maintenance, and your own admin panel.

items.q: How long does it take to deliver my website?
items.a: Less than a month. And we back it with a guarantee: if we don't finish your project in under a month, we refund your first payment.

items.q: Will the code of my website be mine?
items.a: Yes. During the first 12 months the code, design, and domain belong to Judo Marketing, and once you complete your year under contract the code becomes completely yours.

items.q: What payment methods do you accept?
items.a: Credit or debit card and every method Stripe offers, PayPal, Zelle transfer, and USDT crypto (Ethereum network). All payments are in US dollars.
From Miami we serve clients across the United States and Latin America, in Spanish and English. The whole process can happen online, including a Google Meet call.

items.q: What does the monthly fee include?
items.a: Hosting, maintenance, security and daily backups, support, and your admin portal to control your content, users, and sales from one place.

about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: The judo strategy applied to marketing.
about.intro: In judo the biggest fighter doesn't win, the one who turns the opponent's momentum to their advantage does. Judo Marketing was born from that philosophy: we help small and medium businesses compete against giants using technology, artificial intelligence, and strategy as leverage.

sections.title: Use the market's momentum
sections.description: You don't need a corporation's budget. You need to position yourself where the market is already moving: Google searches, social media, and AI automation that works while you sleep.

sections.title: Honesty first
sections.description: In the initial interview we tell you frankly whether we can deliver your project. No smoke, no inflated promises: if we don't deliver your project in under a month, we refund your first payment.

sections.title: Shared prosperity
sections.description: We grow when you grow. That's why every website includes your own control portal, and once you complete your contract year the code is completely yours.

about.intro2: We don't try to stop the big players head on. We ride the momentum that already exists, Google searches, social media, and automation that works while you sleep, and we put it to work for your business.
